abstract: Layer-by-layer debugging workflow for Capacitor 8.5/9 apps: WebView inspection with Safari and Chrome, native debugging with Xcode 27 and Android Studio, simctl/devicectl/adb device control, live reload with cap run --url, an error-string-to-fix table (plugin not implemented, cleartext, ATS, CORS, permissions, white screen), and Capacitor 8.5 UIScene regressions for deep links and pause/resume.
